notes: School of Music official Music - Bachelor of Music - Theory Four Year Academic Plan. Gen Ed and general-elective slots are left out (only the major is audited).

MUSC229 and MUSC099 are repeatable 1-credit courses entered per the plan's own legend lines; see the program's reviewNotes.

The 'MUSC460 or MUSC472' choice is filled with MUSC472; the two 400-level Music Theory elective slots (no specific course named) are filled with MUSC444 and MUSC467; the generic 400-level music-history-elective slot with MUSC443; and the 3-5 credit music-electives floor with MUSC490 -- all real MUSC course numbers named elsewhere in the fetched plan text.
